_about: Company / university VPNs speaking an OpenConnect-supported protocol. flavor: anyconnect (Cisco AnyConnect, ocserv), gp (Palo Alto GlobalProtect), pulse (Pulse/Ivanti Connect Secure), nc (Juniper Network Connect), fortinet (FortiGate SSL VPN), f5 (F5 BIG-IP).
_fill: server, flavor, username, password, and the internal ranges/domains that should go to it (route.rules). auth_group if the portal asks for a group. Certificate login, tokens and host checks have their own sub-options (tls, token, csd, hip, tnc) -- see sing-box's openconnect endpoint docs. SSO/browser-only logins may not work headless.
